correctness.rationale: Variation of constants gives the unique bounded complete lift \(w(t)=\int_0^\infty e^{-bs}x(t-s)\,ds\). Two lifts over the same complete base orbit differ by \(Ce^{-bt}\), which is unbounded backward unless \(C=0\), so compact invariant sets project injectively and hence are continuous invariant graphs. The branch Jacobians are block lower triangular with invariant vertical line exponent \(-b\) and quotient equal to the base tangent cocycle. At a compact-trajectory crossing of \(x=0\), one must have \(y\ne0\), so the crossing is transverse; the continuous vector field gives identity saltation. The packaged symbolic verifier was read and independently checks the block factorization on both smooth branches. The source article's baseline \(b=1\) numerical four-exponent list omits the mandatory exponent \(-1\), and its reported two-positive-exponent intervals under variation of \(b\) cannot be asymptotic full tangent spectra of this printed ODE.
correctness.risk: The Lyapunov statement is for regular ergodic invariant measures and asymptotic tangent exponents, not finite-time numerical estimates.

originality.rationale: The scientific correction is valid, but the mathematical claim is a direct specialization of standard stable linear-filter and linear-cocycle theory to an ODE whose triangular structure is printed explicitly in the 2021 source. The bounded graph formula is immediate variation of constants, while the extra \(-b\) exponent follows from the invariant one-dimensional subbundle and quotient cocycle, exactly the setting of standard multiplicative-ergodic/skew-product theory. Under the required implication-based originality rule, a system-specific restatement does not become original merely because the source article failed to notice the consequence.

final_claim: For the Zhang--Tian--Li--Wu--Cui four-dimensional flow, the added coordinate \(\dot w=x-bw\) with \(b>0\) is a stable linear fiber: compact invariant dynamics are graph-conjugate to the three-dimensional base, and the tangent Lyapunov spectrum is the base spectrum together with the exact exponent \(-b\).
limitations: Compact invariant dynamics and asymptotic regular ergodic tangent spectra only.
No claim is made about finite-time Lyapunov estimates or about classifying the three-dimensional base attractors.
